Question: In perfect competition short-run equilibrium output, AR < SAC but > AVC, then firm ____
Options: A loss, immediate shut down; B loss, but should continue production; C loss, produce or not both okay; D normal profit, continue.

Perfect competition: AR = price P. Short-run shutdown rule: produce if P >= AVC (at minimum AVC shutdown point); if P < AVC shut down. If P between AVC and ATC (SAC), firm incurs loss (since P < ATC) but covers variable cost and some fixed cost, so continue production in short run. So B.

在完全竞争市场中，短期均衡时有 AR = P。

- 若 AR < SAC，说明价格低于平均成本，厂商亏损；
- 若 AR > AVC，说明价格仍能覆盖平均可变成本，并可以弥补一部分固定成本，因此短期应继续生产，而不是立即停产。

答案：B
